verdict.rationale: PostHog's evidence only mentions a self-hosted, open-source Docker Compose deployment (MIT license), which lets a user run PostHog anywhere and thus control data location indirectly, but there is no explicit mention of a managed cloud region-selection feature (e.g., US/EU hosting options) for data residency. missing for 10: explicit cloud region/residency selection option, documentation of specific EU/US data centers, independent confirmation of residency compliance.
